arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Calculate gaps between 13-week and 26-week rates
march_dates = [
    ('March 3', 4.708, 4.943),
    ('March 10', 4.653, 4.965),
    ('March 17', 4.546, 4.813),
    ('March 24', 4.554, 4.826),
    ('March 31', 4.609, 4.869),
]

print('Date        | 13-week | 26-week | Gap')
print('-' * 45)
for date, rate13, rate26 in march_dates:
    gap = abs(rate13 - rate26)
    print(f'{date:10} | {rate13:6.3f} | {rate26:6.3f} | {gap:.3f}')

# Find smallest gap
min_gap = min(march_dates, key=lambda x: abs(x[1] - x[2]))
print(f'\nSmallest gap: {min_gap[0]} with gap of {abs(min_gap[1] - min_gap[2]):.3f}')
"
